concept.name: Cafe 33 Taiwanese Bistro
concept.tagline: Taiwanese bistro in Squirrel Hill South, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Beef Noodle Soup
menu.description: Braised beef shank and tendon in a rich soy-based broth with wheat noodles and bok choy.
menu.imagePrompt: Takeout container of Taiwanese beef noodle soup with sliced braised beef, noodles and green bok choy in dark broth, sealed with a clear lid and paper bag, overhead shot, no text, no people.

menu.name: Three Cup Chicken
menu.description: Bone-in chicken stewed with soy sauce, rice wine and sesame oil, finished with basil.
menu.imagePrompt: Takeout box of Taiwanese three cup chicken with glossy brown sauce, fresh basil leaves and sliced chili on white rice, no text, no people.

menu.name: Braised Pork Rice
menu.description: Ground pork braised in soy and five spice, served over steamed rice with a soft-boiled egg.
menu.imagePrompt: Takeout container of braised pork over white rice with a halved soy-marinated egg and pickled vegetable on the side, no text, no people.

menu.name: Popcorn Chicken
menu.description: Bite-sized fried chicken tossed with basil and chili, a Taiwanese night market favorite.
menu.imagePrompt: Paper bag and small takeout box of crispy fried chicken bites with green basil leaves and red chili flakes, no text, no people.

menu.name: Scallion Pancake
menu.description: Flaky, layered flatbread studded with scallions, pan-fried until golden.
menu.imagePrompt: Wedge-cut scallion pancake in a takeout box, golden layers visible, no text, no people.

menu.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
menu.description: Wok-fried rice with egg, seasonal vegetables and soy sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: Takeout container of fried rice with egg ribbons, peas and carrots, no text, no people.

menu.name: Bubble Milk Tea
menu.description: Black tea with milk and chewy tapioca pearls, served cold.
menu.imagePrompt: Plastic cup of bubble milk tea with black tapioca pearls and a wide straw, sealed lid, no text, no people.

menu.name: Beef Noodle Combo
menu.description: Beef noodle soup served with popcorn chicken and a side of pickled greens.
menu.imagePrompt: Takeout meal with a container of beef noodle soup beside a small box of popcorn chicken and pickled greens, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark pairing a simple steaming bowl silhouette with the number 33 in a clean sans-serif, in deep red and cream.
brand.voice: Friendly and unfussy, speaking to neighbors as if they were regulars stopping in for a comforting bowl.
